text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh... Um, well... First, happy birthday,<n>Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Y-you see... I wanna make dinner for<n>you tonight...
It's hokki meshi.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You told me once you wanted to try it!<n>So I went and
ordered some good<n>surf clams from my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm not sure I'll do it<n>justice... or if
homemade cooking<n>would even count as a present!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: No way! I'm sure it'll be really good!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hokki meshi, straight from the<n>tourism ambassador
of Tomakomai?<n>And you must know the best recipe
there is since you're great at<n>cooking!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, just thinking about it's making<n>me hungry!
Hehe, I can't wait to try it!<n>♪
